cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; a sunny concrete skate park of smooth bowls and ramps — frames a shot on a smartphone held out in both hands; a beach club of white daybeds and parasols on the sand — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a dark jellyfish room — slips the corner of a freshly printed instant photo into an album; a sunlit white marble temple — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a cinema lobby with a popcorn counter — crouching down low; a small open pavilion with upturned eaves perched on a sheer mountain cliff above a sea of clouds — sitting on the ground; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a glassy turquoise cove in the morning — standing balanced on her board; a towering magic library where books drift slowly through the air between tall shelves — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — in warrior two pose on a yoga mat; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — holds her keepsake up beside her face
